fato_historico: 2012: Canada officially cuts diplomatic ties with Iran by closing its embassy in Tehran and orders the expulsion of Iranian diplomats from Ottawa, over nuclear plans and purported human rights abuses.
energia_do_dia: The cosmos suggests it is a good time to reflect on boundaries and connection. Much like shifting global tides that redefine how distant lands communicate, you may find yourself reevaluating your internal borders. Perhaps it is time to release outdated walls and embrace a fresh, harmonious dialogue with your inner self to foster personal growth and clarity.
frase_do_dia: True strength lies in the grace of knowing when to bridge the gap.
significado_numero: Represents the inner wisdom gained through reflection and quiet contemplation.
conselho: Consider opening your heart to new perspectives instead of clinging to familiar defenses.
